changelog: LOTS of improvements added. Here we go!: Added new shid to the outside perimeter with new and special surprises. Adjusted outside the main entrance to include a ruddy greyt tractor and shotgun in tow. Damn kids!. Added a toilet shack to the slurry pit. Many more gardening items can now be picked up. Added new Trac-or to outside the slurry pit. The Water Tower can be explored fully again. Adjusted routines on top of the fruit warehouse to be less annoying and face AWAY from the tower in most circumstances. Added more cover in the main houses garden so the crate nearby can be more safely used. Sevceral windows that are open can now be climbed into more easily, avoiding the janky box hopping, affecting the Fruit Warehouse toilet and the Main House Garden windows. Added more cover to various aspects of the Fruit Orchard to make certain spots safer to hide in. Added vision blockers to the overgrown grassy-mess area, and moved boxes to make traversal less slow, and to avoid the attention of nearby guards so frequently. The barn roof can now be traversed, and the scaffolding trespass area and guards have been adjusted to make it a more obvious trespassing area. Added the elusive Noel Crest to the militia more permanantly. Added pathfinding objects to certain grassy sections to avoid accidental guard altercations. Added rakes and hammers, and moved one banana to the shid. Whew! This was many months of arduous work, testing, and Navkit compiling. Enjoy everyone!
